en: The Magnet Train to Saffron City in Kanto is about to leave. Would you like to board?
All aboard! Please stand clear of the doors.
The Magnet Train glided out of Goldenrod, floating silently east toward Kanto...
The trains run all day. Come back whenever you're ready.
The Magnet Train runs between Goldenrod City and Saffron City in Kanto.
For now its seats are kept for those the League has named Champion. Win at the Indigo Plateau, and you can ride.
